title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
title_zh: < Player-1：通过合成经验学习游戏操作

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1 , a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym , sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机操作智能体在解读屏幕以及执行键盘和鼠标操作方面已展现出强大能力。 然而，游戏凭借其视觉丰富的世界和多样化的机制，仍然充满挑战，并构成了迈向通用数字控制的一个高难度下一步。 当前的游戏智能体学习流程通常依赖大规模演示，但这些演示对动态游戏状态的覆盖有限，而可用于交互式训练的可扩展环境仍难以获取。 我们提出了 Player-1，一个后训练框架，能够通过合成经验学习超越演示范围的游戏控制能力。 我们通过相对指针移动、持续输入和组合操作扩展了计算机操作的动作空间。 为了进行监督初始化，我们在 6,044 条精心挑选的游戏轨迹上对计算机操作模型进行了微调，这些轨迹将记录的操作与任务指令及视觉推理相结合。 我们构建了 Player-1-Gym，这是一个包含十六个合成 2D 和 3D 环境的项目，其设计围绕跨游戏共通的控制需求展开。 程序上可验证的奖励机制以及随机化的观察和控制动态，支持了基于 PPO 的多环境强化学习。 由此生成的 Player-1-9B 和 Player-1-35B-A3B 在 MineDojo-300 任务中的成功率分别比其 SFT 策略提升了 27.8 和 17.7 个百分点。 Player-1-9B 的成功率达到了 38.33%，而评估中表现最强的基线模型仅为 12.63%；在 ViZDoom-10 和 GameWorld 上，其性能也进一步优于 SFT。 进一步分析表明，更广泛的合成环境覆盖能够提升迁移效果，而在强化学习过程中，结合多种键盘和鼠标输入的组合操作使用频率也会增加。 我们证明，通过合成经验进行学习能够显著提升游戏控制能力，这种提升不仅超越了监督初始化的阶段，还具备超出强化学习训练集之外的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Foundation models have developed broad capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and instruction following ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Gemini Team, 2025 ) . Computer-use agents bring these capabilities to digital interfaces, interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Games offer a demanding next step toward general digital control: their visually complex environments and diverse mechanics require precise, sustained, and concurrent control under dynamic and rapidly changing visual feedback ( Luo et al., 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: Recent game agents learn from large-scale gameplay demonstrations and interactive experience ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Magne et al., 2026 ; SIMA Team, 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Yet demonstrations cover only a limited portion of the states an agent may encounter in open-ended tasks, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. Despite differences in appearance and rules, we find that many games share recurring control demands such as precise aiming, sustained movement, and coordinated inputs. This motivates our central question: Can synthetic experience advance game-control capabilities beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize to games outside the RL training suite?
paragraphs.zh: 近期的游戏智能体通过大规模游戏玩法演示和互动经验进行学习（Wang 等人，2025b；Magne 等人，2026；SIMA 团队，2025；Shi 等人，2026）。 然而，演示仅涵盖了智能体在开放任务中可能遇到的状态的一小部分，而可用于互动训练的可扩展环境仍然难以获取。 尽管外观和规则存在差异，我们发现许多游戏都共享一些重复出现的控制需求，例如精准瞄准、持续移动和协调输入。 这引出了我们的核心问题：合成经验能否在监督初始化之外进一步提升游戏控制能力，并且这种提升能否推广到强化学习训练套件之外的游戏？

paragraphs.en: Three challenges shape this approach. First, gameplay demonstrations recorded with heterogeneous input conventions and temporal resolutions must be converted into a shared action space, and paired with task instructions and visual reasoning that reflect the player’s intent. Second, learning beyond demonstrations requires feedback on states reached by the policy’s own actions, but implementing programmatic rewards across diverse commercial games is difficult to scale. Third, experience from environments with different control demands, dynamics, and reward scales must be incorporated into a shared policy that generalizes beyond the training suite. These challenges motivate our supervised initialization from curated demonstrations, followed by learning in controllable synthetic environments with verifiable rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 有三个挑战构成了这一方法的核心。 首先，必须以异质输入规范和不同时间分辨率录制的游戏过程演示，转换为共享的动作空间，并与体现玩家意图的任务说明和视觉推理相结合。 其次，超越演示的学习需要基于策略自身动作所达到的状态提供反馈，但在多样化的商业游戏中实现程序化奖励的扩展存在困难。 第三，来自具有不同控制需求、动态机制和奖励尺度的环境的经验，必须被整合到一个能够超越训练集实现泛化的共享策略中。 这些挑战促使我们采用从精选演示数据开始的监督初始化方法，随后在具有可验证奖励的可控合成环境中进行学习。

sents.zh: 可通过程序验证的奖励机制，结合随机化的观察与控制动态，为超越演示的多环境强化学习提供了多样化的经验。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience advances game-control capabilities beyond supervised demonstrations : Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B gain 27.8 and 17.7 pp in MineDojo-300 success, respectively, with further gains on ViZDoom and GameWorld outside the RL training suite. Further analyses show improved transfer with broader environment coverage and increased composite-action use during RL.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，从合成经验中学习能够将游戏控制能力提升至超越监督演示的水平：Player-1-9B 和 Player-1-35B-A3B 在 MineDojo-300 任务中的成功率分别提升了 27.8 和 17.7 个百分点，并且在强化学习训练套件之外的 ViZDoom 和 GameWorld 任务中也有进一步的提升。 进一步的分析表明，更广泛的环境覆盖以及在强化学习过程中更多使用组合动作，能够促进迁移效果的提升。

paragraphs.en: Foundation models provide broad language, reasoning, and multimodal capabilities that underpin general-purpose agents ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Gemini Team, 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Vision-language models (VLMs) connect visual perception with language, supporting scene understanding and spatial grounding ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Computer-use agents (CUAs) specialize these capabilities for screenshot-conditioned interaction, using keyboard and mouse actions to complete multi-step tasks ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Lu et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Game-agent research spans planning-based systems ( Tan et al., 2025b ) , learned visual policies and vision–language–action (VLA) models ( SIMA Team, 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Magne et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) , and joint video–action models ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Reinforcement learning further supports self-improvement and long-horizon control ( SIMA Team, 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Most recently, Jev demonstrates low-latency game control through a text-only interface, relying on structured game-state representations rather than screenshot observations ( Almeida, 2026 ) . Complementary benchmarks evaluate gameplay ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) and agentic game development ( Chi et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b ) . Code world models synthesized from rules and trajectories support planning ( Lehrach et al., 2026 ) , while game engine development provides trajectory data for world-model training ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , connecting game creation to learning ( Luo et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 游戏智能体研究涵盖基于规划的系统（Tan 等人，2025b）、通过学习获得的视觉策略以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（SIMA 团队，2024；Tan 等人，2025a；Li 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2025b；Magne 等人，2026；Yue 等人，2026），以及联合视频-动作模型（Guo 等人，2026）。 强化学习进一步支持了自我改进和长期控制（SIMA 团队，2025；Shi 等人，2026）。 最近，Jev 通过纯文本界面实现了低延迟的游戏控制，该方法依赖结构化的游戏状态表示，而非屏幕截图观察（Almeida，2026）。 补充的基准测试用于评估游戏玩法（Ouyang 等人，2026）以及智能体驱动的游戏开发（Chi 等人，2026；Luo 等人，2026b）。 由规则和轨迹合成的代码世界模型支持规划（Lehrach 等人，2026），而游戏引擎开发则为世界模型的训练提供了轨迹数据（Zhou 等人，2026），从而将游戏创作与学习联系起来（Luo 等人，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: We curate 6,044 gameplay trajectories comprising 295,097 interaction turns from public datasets ( Choi et al., 2026 ; Markov AI, 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ; Baker et al., 2022 ) and in-house recordings, mapping recorded controls to the shared game-control action space defined in Section 3.1 . Controls are aligned to shared action intervals, and source-specific mouse calibration expresses relative inputs in normalized, pixel-equivalent coordinates. After filtering incomplete or redundant recordings, we use a VLM ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) to annotate the recorded actions with task instructions and per-turn visual reasoning. For reasoning annotation, the VLM conditions on the task instruction, current and past observations, and the action target. Figure 2 illustrates input coverage and an annotated demonstration. Appendix B details the sources, alignment, calibration, and annotation procedures.

paragraphs.en: We construct Player-1-Gym , a suite of synthetic environments organized around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards, together with randomized observations and control dynamics, support our multi-environment PPO training of the SFT-initialized policy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 Player-1-Gym，这是一套围绕跨游戏共通的控制需求而组织的合成环境。 程序上可验证的奖励，结合随机化的观察与控制动态，支持我们对经过 SFT 初始化的策略进行多环境 PPO 训练。

paragraphs.en: We identify recurring control demands across games and organize training tasks into five families: aiming, combat, driving, navigation, and UI interaction. For example, aiming tasks require pointer-based or camera-relative target tracking, while combat tasks combine movement with attack timing. Building upon our own shared 2D and 3D engines, reusable assets, and scene templates, we implement sixteen environments that require these forms of control through different game mechanics, viewpoints, and spatial layouts, as shown in Figure 3 (a–b). A unified runtime provides screenshot observations and executes the shared game-control action space. This shared foundation facilitates extending the suite with new environments while maintaining consistent observation and action interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出不同游戏中反复出现的控制需求，并将训练任务组织为五个类别：瞄准、战斗、驾驶、导航和 UI 交互。例如，瞄准任务需要基于指针或相机相对位置的目標追蹤，而战斗任务则将移动与攻击时机相结合。基于我们自有的共享 2D 和 3D 引擎、可重复使用的资产以及场景模板，我们实现了十六个环境，这些环境通过不同的游戏机制、视角和空间布局要求上述控制形式，如圖 3（a–b）所示。一个统一的运行时系统提供屏幕截图观察结果，并执行共享的游戏控制动作空间。这一共享基础使得在保持观察和动作接口一致性的同时，能够轻松扩展该套件以加入新的环境。

paragraphs.en: To provide verifiable training feedback, each environment defines game- and task-specific scoring rules over changing game states. Score increments supply step-level rewards, providing dense and verifiable feedback without a learned judge, while privileged state is not exposed to the policy.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提供可验证的训练反馈，每个环境都会针对不断变化的游戏状态定义特定的游戏和任务评分规则。 分数增量提供了步骤级的奖励，无需依赖学习到的评判者即可实现密集且可验证的反馈，同时特权状态也不会暴露给策略。

paragraphs.en: To further broaden training experience within each environment, we randomize four complementary dimensions in Player-1-Gym : (1) Appearance : colors, lighting, and assets; (2) Camera : projection, placement, and initial orientation; (3) Scene : layouts, spawns, and task-specific configurations; and (4) Control : input-response gains for camera rotation, movement, driving, and steering where applicable. All four dimensions are jointly randomized during training where supported. Examples are provided in Figure 3 (c). Appendix C further specifies the distributions and per-environment settings.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步丰富每个环境中的训练体验，我们在 Player-1-Gym 中随机调整了四个互补的维度：(1) 外观：颜色、光照和资产；(2) 摄像头：投影方式、位置和初始方向；(3) 场景：布局、生成点以及任务特定的配置；以及 (4) 控制：适用于摄像头旋转、移动、驾驶和转向时的输入-响应增益。 在训练过程中，只要环境支持，这四个维度都会被联合随机化。 相关示例见第 3 图 (c)。 附录 C 进一步说明了各分布以及每个环境的具体设置。

paragraphs.en: We initialize Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B from their respective Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B backbones. Both undergo two epochs of SFT on the full demonstration dataset with action-balanced sampling. We then apply proximal policy optimization (PPO) in the sixteen-environment Player-1-Gym suite. paragraphs.en: Besides in-domain evaluation of sixteen Player-1-Gym environments, we construct two evaluation suites: MineDojo-300, comprising 300 tasks from the MineDojo ( Fan et al., 2022 ) task collection in Minecraft, and ViZDoom-10, comprising ten maps from the twelve available maps in ViZDoom ( Kempka et al., 2016 ) . We also evaluate browser-game interaction on GameWorld ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) , covering 170 tasks across 34 games. Our standardized evaluation protocols use 8 trials per MineDojo task, 50 per ViZDoom map, and 3 per GameWorld task. Appendix E details benchmark composition, metrics, and budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 除了对十六个 Player-1-Gym 环境进行领域内评估外，我们还构建了两套评估套件：MineDojo-300，包含来自 MineDojo（Fan et al., 2022）Minecraft 任务集里的 300 项任务；以及 ViZDoom-10，包含 ViZDoom（Kempka et al., 2016）中可用十二张地图里的十张地图。 我们还评估了 GameWorld（Ouyang et al., 2026）中的浏览器游戏交互能力，涵盖 34 款游戏中的 170 项任务。 我们的标准化评估协议规定：每个 MineDojo 任务进行 8 次试验，每张 ViZDoom 地图进行 50 次试验，每个 GameWorld 任务进行 3 次试验。 附录 E 详细说明了基准测试的组成、指标和预算。

paragraphs.en: The same policy improves performance on external games. On ViZDoom-10, Player-1-9B increases scaled return from 0.4361 after SFT to 0.6922. On GameWorld’s 3 × 170 3\times 170 episodes, progress rises from 31.43% to 34.45%. paragraphs.en: We presented Player-1 , a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. Curated gameplay demonstrations initialize computer-use models in a shared game-control action space. Player-1-Gym then provides sixteen synthetic environments organized around shared control demands, with verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics for multi-environment RL. Evaluations on MineDojo-300, ViZDoom-10, and GameWorld demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience advances game-control capabilities beyond SFT, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite. Further analyses show improved transfer with larger training suites. Together, these findings establish synthetic experience as an effective resource for learning transferable game control without online training in each target game.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Player-1，一个训练后框架，它通过合成经验学习超越演示的游戏控制能力。 精心挑选的游戏玩法演示为共享游戏控制动作空间中的计算机使用模型提供初始化。 Player-1-Gym 随后提供了十六个围绕共享控制需求组织的合成环境，这些环境具有可验证的奖励、随机化的观察结果以及适用于多环境强化学习的控制动态。 在 MineDojo-300、ViZDoom-10 和 GameWorld 上的评估表明，通过合成经验学习能够超越 SFT 提升游戏控制能力，且这种提升效果能泛化到强化学习训练套件之外的场景。 进一步的分析显示，随着训练套件的扩大，迁移效果也会得到改善。 综合来看，这些研究结果确立了合成经验作为学习可迁移游戏控制的有效资源，而无需在每个目标游戏中进行在线训练。

paragraphs.en: We automated validity, activity, and repetition checks that complement source-level and manual review of recording completeness, observation–action alignment, and sequence diversity. The collection contains 5,360 gameplay trajectories with a total of 268,000 turns and 684 in-game UI trajectories with a total of 27,097 turns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们实现了有效性、活跃性和重复性检查的自动化，这些检查与源级审查和手动审查相辅相成，用于验证记录完整性、观察与行动的一致性以及序列多样性。 该数据集包含 5,360 条游戏轨迹，总回合数为 268,000；同时包含 684 条游戏内用户界面轨迹，总回合数为 27,097。

paragraphs.en: For continuous gameplay, source timestamps define contiguous intervals of 150–250 ms, projected onto a 200-ms target grid using cumulative boundaries. Relative input is summed within each source interval. Keyboard presses shorter than 100 ms become taps, and longer presses become holds on overlapping target steps. Mouse presses lasting at most 300 ms become clicks. Each target summarizes compatible recorded inputs for concurrent execution within one control step.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现连续的游戏流程，源时间戳定义了 150–250 毫秒的连续区间，并通过累积边界映射到 200 毫秒的目标网格上。 相对输入在每个源区间内被累加。 持续时间短于 100 毫秒的键盘按键会变为轻触，而更长的按键则会在重叠的目标步骤中变为持续按住。 持续时间最长为 300 毫秒的鼠标按键会变为点击。 每个目标都会对兼容的已记录输入进行总结，以便在一个控制步骤内同步执行。

paragraphs.en: UI trajectories also follow recorded operation boundaries. Clicks retain their recorded targets, key sequences expand into individual presses, drags use start and endpoint controls with an explicit release, and scroll gestures become directional steps. paragraphs.en: In human gameplay recordings, some actions occupy only a small fraction of playing time but are critical for game progress. For example, left mouse button inputs account for less than 1% of valid inputs in the original recordings, which are dominated by keyboard inputs and mouse movement. In addition to selecting and filtering demonstrations for action coverage during data curation, we use action-balanced sampling to strengthen supervision for these infrequent but important actions. We classify each turn by its current recorded action into overlapping pools: keyboard, mouse movement, click, hold, any mouse button, keyboard–mouse, movement–click, keyboard–click, and keyboard–movement–click. Keyboard includes held and tapped keys; keyboard–mouse includes any mouse input, including scrolling. Other contains the remaining turns, including wait and scroll-only actions. Each draw selects a pool proportionally to its weight (1 for each control pool; 0.1 for Other), then samples a turn uniformly with replacement.
paragraphs.zh: 在人类游戏过程的记录中，某些操作虽然仅占极短的游戏时间，但对游戏进展却至关重要。 例如，在原始记录中，左键点击在所有有效输入中的占比不足 1%，而键盘输入和鼠标移动则占据了主导地位。 除了在数据整理过程中选择并筛选具有操作覆盖性的演示样本外，我们还采用均衡采样方法，以加强对这些低频但关键操作的监督。 我们将每个回合根据其当前记录的操作，分类到多个重叠的池子中：键盘、鼠标移动、点击、长按、任意鼠标按钮、键盘–鼠标、移动–点击、键盘–点击，以及键盘–移动–点击。 “键盘”池包含被长按或轻触的按键；“键盘–鼠标”池则包含任何鼠标输入，包括滚动操作。 “其他”池则包含剩余的回合，包括等待和仅滚动的操作。 每次抽取时，系统会按照各池子的权重比例进行选择（每个控制池的权重为 1，“其他”池的权重为 0.1），然后以有放回的方式均匀采样一个回合。

paragraphs.en: Our full MineDojo-300, ViZDoom-10, and GameWorld protocols allocate up to 3.14 million agent decision turns per model. Our in-suite validation records average roughly 3,000 input tokens and 100 output tokens per turn, including visual context and generated reasoning. Using these observed lengths as a workload proxy, a full-budget evaluation would cost approximately USD$110,000 at GPT-6 Astra’s standard API rates of USD$10 and USD$50 per million input and output tokens, respectively, before caching discounts. 1 1 1 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra , accessed Sep 24, 2026. paragraphs.zh: 我们完整的 MineDojo-300、ViZDoom-10 和 GameWorld 协议为每个模型分配了最多 314 万个智能体决策回合。 我们的内部验证记录显示，每个回合平均约有 3,000 个输入令牌和 100 个输出令牌，包括视觉上下文和生成的推理过程。 将这些观测到的长度作为工作负载的代理指标，在 GPT-6 Astra 的标准 API 费率（每百万输入和输出令牌分别收费 10 美元和 50 美元）下，一次全预算评估的费用约为 11 万美元，且未计入缓存折扣。1 1 1 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra ，访问于 2026 年 9 月 24 日。 实际成本取决于模型特定的分词方式、推理过程以及回合长度。 考虑到估算成本，我们的重点主要放在已发布的代表性游戏控制和计算机使用策略上，而非专有 API 模型。

paragraphs.en: We deploy JARVIS-VLA with its action-token decoder and two history entries to predict one action per decision. UI-TARS-1.5-7B uses three previous screenshots, deterministic decoding, and a 400-token output limit. Its adapter maps pixel-coordinate actions to one benchmark interval, with drag and double-click unsupported. NitroGen aggregates an 18-action chunk into six benchmark decisions (three native actions per decision), refreshing the image after each chunk. GameWAM predicts 16 actions and executes eight before replanning, using its Minecraft checkpoint outside Doom and its ViZDoom checkpoint for Doom. Open-P2P uses visual-only conditioning and session-specific recurrent state. All temporal inference state is isolated between episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们部署了 JARVIS-VLA，它使用动作标记解码器和两条历史记录来为每个决策预测一个动作。 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 使用三张之前的截图、确定性解码以及 400 个标记的输出限制。 其适配器将像素坐标动作映射到一个基准区间，但不支持拖拽和双击操作。 NitroGen 将包含 18 个动作的片段汇总为六个基准决策（每个决策包含三个原生动作），并在每个片段结束后刷新图像。 GameWAM 会预测 16 个动作，在执行八个动作后重新规划；它在 Doom 环境中使用 Minecraft 的检查点，在 Doom 环境中则使用其 ViZDoom 检查点。 Open-P2P 仅使用视觉条件输入和会话特定的循环状态。 所有时间序列推理状态在不同回合之间均相互隔离。

paragraphs.en: GameWorld includes 170 tasks across 34 diverse browser games. We evaluate our model for three trials with seeds 0, 1, and 2 (Table 12 ). The policy receives screenshots, rules, and instructions, while evaluator state is hidden. Action duration, observation geometry, and admissible controls follow each game’s configuration, and multi-role games keep separate histories. Success is the fraction of trials reporting completion, while progress is the achieved fraction from its initial value to its target, clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . The evaluator averages objectives and retains the best task progress reached. Reported success and progress average trials within each task, then equally across tasks.
